sources.locator: PDF pp. 2-7 and 11-12: the section heading "Hensel's Lemma and coefficient fields in equal characteristic 0", Theorem (Hensel's Lemma), the characteristic-0 coefficient-field theorem, the proposition on maps from A[[X_1, ..., X_n]] to a complete local ring, the theorem on module-finite parameter subrings and injectivity, and the characteristic-p p-basis coefficient-field theorem.

contents.name: Theorem (Hensel's Lemma)
Theorem (a complete local ring containing a field of characteristic 0 has a coefficient field)
Proposition (the unique continuous map A[[X_1, ..., X_n]] -> R, together with the m-primary and residue-field consequences)
Theorem (if x_1, ..., x_n generate an m-primary ideal then R is module-finite over A[[X_1, ..., X_n]], and in the parameter/domain case the map is injective)
Corollary (equicharacteristic regular local rings complete to power series rings)
Theorem (characteristic-p coefficient fields via a lifted p-basis), especially the completeness-driven root-lifting step
